# Streamer Times

> Your Livestream Guide for Twitch & YouTube. AI-powered predictions of when
> streamers go live, real-time go-live alerts, an EPG grid, and live status —
> free on iOS & Android and on the web.

Streamer Times tracks Twitch and YouTube streamers, detects cross-platform
channels, and predicts upcoming stream schedules from streaming history and AI
transcript analysis. Canonical domain: https://streamertimes.tv

## Core pages
- [Home / live schedule](https://streamertimes.tv/): Real-time live status and AI-powered schedule predictions.
- [Who's live now](https://streamertimes.tv/live): Every streamer live right now, grouped by game and category.
- [Streaming tonight](https://streamertimes.tv/tonight): This evening's line-up hour by hour, from 6 PM to 6 AM — announced streams plus AI-predicted starts.
- [Games & categories](https://streamertimes.tv/games): Find streamers by the game or category they play.
- [All streamers A–Z](https://streamertimes.tv/streamers): Full A–Z index of tracked Twitch and YouTube streamers.
- [Streamer rankings](https://streamertimes.tv/rankings): Leaderboards — most followed, most watched, most active and most punctual streamers, updated daily.
- [Best games to stream](https://streamertimes.tv/best-games-to-stream): Categories ranked by viewers per live channel — where a new stream is easiest to find, updated daily.
- [Get the app](https://streamertimes.tv/app): Go-live alerts and AI stream predictions, free for iOS and Android.

## Detail pages
- Streamer schedule: https://streamertimes.tv/streamer/{id}
- Game / category hub: https://streamertimes.tv/game/{slug}
- Per-game ranking: https://streamertimes.tv/rankings/game/{slug}
- Best time to stream a game: https://streamertimes.tv/game/{slug}/best-time

## How it works
- [How predictions and confidence levels work](https://streamertimes.tv/methodology/predictions): How Streamer Times predicts when a streamer goes live — broadcast history, announced schedules and what streamers say on stream — and what the HIGH, MEDIUM and LOW confidence badges mean.
- [How we estimate streamer income](https://streamertimes.tv/methodology/income-estimates): The model behind the estimated monthly income on wiki profiles.

## Developers
- [Partner API](https://streamertimes.tv/developers): Public REST API for live schedules and AI predictions (waitlist).
